23:105.text: , "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

23:106.text: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

23:107.text: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return

23:108.text: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

23:109.text: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

23:110.text: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

23:111.text: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers

23:112.text: will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

23:113.text: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

23:114.text: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

23:115.text: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

23:116.text: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign,
there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

23:117.text: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

23:118.text: , say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
